$meta.title: Employment and inactivity, residents aged 16 to 64, single years and three year means

measures.definition: People aged 16 to 64 in employment as a percentage of all residents aged 16 to 64, APS
Economically inactive residents aged 16 to 64 as a percentage of all residents aged 16 to 64, APS

$meta.table: LI01, sheet LI01, one October edition a year (November 2015 for the first)
$meta.edition: November 2015 and October 2016 to October 2026 editions
$meta.caveat: Survey rates. The Annual Population Survey lost its accreditation in 2025. Burnley's single years change by up to 11 points from one year to the next, so the solid line is the mean of three consecutive readings, derived here; single years are shown faint.
$meta.rules: No company or person is named. No estimate is shown as fact. Derived figures carry their arithmetic.
